text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... phew.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(......
Maybe I should head back soon.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (No, but just a little more—so I can offer that golden bouquet to her.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(To claim the grand oak flower
at the Oaks—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Day after day was spent in rigorous training towards the Oaks."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, one day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Trainer!
Loves-san is on the special TV broadcast—!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Undefeated with three consecutive wins since her debut, it's Loves Only You!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
"Missing the Oka Sho was unfortunate, but no one
will forget her three-length victory at the
Wasurenagusa Sho after her comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank you very much♡
It looks like I'll be able to run in the Oaks without issue, so I'm thrilled♪

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks will be her very first GⅠ race—
The high expectations placed on Loves-san are clear
from the sheer number of reporters gathered here today!"

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You, a rising star on par with
Chrono Genesis and Gran Alegria.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'd like to take a deep dive into her relationship
with her "Commu-Members"~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just taking a break from my nighttime training♪
'You've been doing a lot of extra training lately.'
—Well, yeah, now's the time to give it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, "Gym Rat Middle-Aged Guy"-san. The protein
you recommended the other day was delicious♡
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You, who has been streaming
since she was a young girl."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Supporting her are the Commu-members:
the members of the community she runs."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
To me, a Twinkle Series where
I cannot walk alongside them is simply unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
They are the ones who have watched over my growth
for so, so long.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
They are comrades who gave me so much love,
and who received so much love from me in return.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I want to win on the big stage and prove just how wonderful the bond and love of this community truly are."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Across all of Japan... no, across the whole wide world.
If it's for that, I can work as hard as it takes ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You
crosses the finish line in a majestic 1st place!!"

text_block_list.name: Community Member
text_block_list.text:
"UOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!"
"That's our Loves-chan!" "You're number one!"
"We'll be cheering for you next time too! Let's do our best together!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To make her dream come true, the community members never miss a day of work either."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Hype up her streams, and trend on social media. Loves Only You's races have always been backed by her community members."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'What kind of answer will this new form
of Uma Musume and fans lead to?'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "You will surely find that answer soon—along with an overwhelming amount of love."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —What a lovely story.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing stories about the bond between Loves-san
and the Commu-members warms my heart just listening to it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a whim, I opened social media.
Naturally, the name "Loves Only You"
was trending at the top.

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"'That community's been around for a long time, huh?'
'I heard she knows every member's name.'
'There's something romantic about that, makes you want to support her.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aside from comments from the commu-members,
there were also many comments expressing
great interest in their relationship.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: My—it truly is the center of attention, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Besides... for some reason, it's made me
really want to train.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want to lose to this momentum.
I have to... do my best too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired and spurred on by Loves Only You,
the days leading up to the Oaks took on
even greater intensity and spirit—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
...Ngh, just a little bit more...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Taah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the battle to crown the Queen of Oaks!
Which Umamusume will seize the glory...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Today, without fail, I will grasp that shining blossom in my own hands...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, —?
That's—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...-san. Ai-Oshi Samurai-san.
Harukaze-san. Iwashi Dango-san. Night Shift Regular-san.
Mach Guitar-san. Pencil-san. Tenten-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone,
thank you for always being by my side...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone, I made it this far.
I overcame injuries and anxieties alike.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So today, I will show everyone.
The greatest love in history—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, Bouquet-chan.
Let us engage in the finest clash of love.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I don't want to lose in spirit...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it's a victory for someone's sake, even I—
have someone I want to dedicate it to...!
